question: How long do States or other Federal agencies with their own MUTCDs or supplements have to revise them into substantial conformance after changes to the National MUTCD become effective?
model_answer: Direct Answer: States or other Federal agencies with their own MUTCDs or Supplements must revise them to be in substantial conformance with changes to the National MUTCD within 2 years of the effective date of the Final Rule adopting those changes. This requirement also extends to agency policies, directives, specifications, or standard drawings that modify Standard, Guidance, or Option provisions, since those documents are considered supplements to the MUTCD. Standards (mandatory): - "States or other Federal agencies that have their own MUTCDs or Supplements shall revise these MUTCDs or Supplements to be in substantial conformance with changes to the National MUTCD within 2 years of the effective date of the Final Rule for the changes [23 CFR 655.603(b)(3)]. Substantial conformance of such State or other Federal agency MUTCDs or Supplements shall be as defined in 23 CFR 655.603(b)(1)." - "For the purposes of Paragraph 2 of this Section, policies, directives, specifications, standard drawings, or similar documents that are issued by an agency and that change or modify Standard, Guidance, or Option provisions in this Manual shall be considered as supplements to the MUTCD and shall also be revised to be in substantial conformance with the National MUTCD." - "After the effective date of a new edition of the MUTCD or a revision thereto, or after the adoption thereof by the State, whichever occurs later, new or reconstructed devices installed shall comply with the new edition or revision, as required by 23 CFR 655.603." Visual evidence: [Image 2] (Figure 1B-2) illustrates the rulemaking process in which the FHWA publishes a Final Rule, after which State manuals must be brought into substantial conformance with the National MUTCD. [Image 3] (Table 1B-1) shows examples of separate target compliance dates the FHWA has established for particular MUTCD provisions, which is a related but distinct mechanism from the 2-year conformance requirement. Citations: - Section 1B.02 Standard §2 (p.4) - Section 1B.02 Standard §3 (p.5) - Section 1B.03 Standard §3 (p.5) - Section 1B.03 Support §6 (p.5) - Figure 1B-2 (p.9) - Table 1B-1 (p.5)
gold_answer: They must revise their MUTCDs or supplements into substantial conformance within 2 years of the effective date of the Final Rule for the changes.
